Verification of compliance with rules and procedures, advise on sound financial management, liaise with relevant services in Headquarters, budgetary and financial management; analysis and follow-up of findings of expenditure verification reports and audit reports; financial analysis in the calculation of recovery orders and eligibility of expenditure in contracts; analysis of indicators for payments or disbursements; PROCUREMENT AND CONTRACT MANAGEMENT: Financial initiator for Tenders and Call for proposals including Terms of Reference, Technical Specifications, Tender dossier; Participation in evaluation committees, including the preparation of the reports.
